resolved_findings.reasoning: Each completed refresh records its own status in _view_status, including either the exact calculation time/disclaimer for displayed rows or the read-failure status after clearing rows. Successful and failed imports compose only their current result with this stored refresh status. A failed import therefore retains the original timestamp that qualifies unchanged age rows; repeated failures cannot accumulate earlier import messages. A subsequent successful refresh replaces the age and reference timestamp together. Post-import query failures remain visible because refresh stores the failure status before the success import summary is composed.
resolved_findings.coverage: The new regression starts with a populated table, advances the clock by one day, fails JSON import twice, and asserts unchanged age, original calculation timestamp, source-freshness disclaimer, one error message and unchanged persisted records. It then refreshes and checks the age and timestamp advance. Existing successful-import and post-import-read-failure tests remain present in the matching 18-test saved run.
